title: Ares Deep
summary: A five-person research outpost on the rim of Hellas Planitia, Mars, nine weeks from help. Everyone knows everyone's habits, not their secrets.
toneNote: Quiet, grounded hard SF; tension comes from secrets and pressure more than action.
setting: Ares Deep is a five-person research outpost dug into the rim of Hellas Planitia on Mars, 214 sols into a 500-sol rotation. The nearest help is a cargo lander nine weeks out, and Earth is 14 light-minutes away. The station is cramped; everyone knows everyone's habits, but not their secrets. Whether the program gets a second rotation depends on what this crew sends home.
rules: Grounded near-future technology. No aliens, no magic. Any biological discovery is microbial at most and must stay scientifically plausible.
Mars is lethal: suit breaches, CO2 buildup, cold, radiation and dust are real dangers. Going outside requires a suit.
Messages to Earth take 14 minutes each way. There is no real-time help.
The crew are capable professionals under strain. Conflict comes from personality, pressure and secrets, not villainy.

locations.name: Commons
locations.desc: Hub module with the galley table and the station's only real window.

locations.name: Ops & Comms
locations.desc: Status boards, the long-delay comm link and the station logs.

locations.name: Med Bay
locations.desc: Two cots, a scanner and a locked drug cabinet.

locations.name: Lab
locations.desc: Core sample racks, a glovebox and incubators for ice cultures.

locations.name: Hydroponics
locations.desc: Grow racks under purple light and the water recycler, rattling.

locations.name: Crew Quarters
locations.desc: Five curtained bunks. The only privacy on the station.

locations.name: Suit Room & Airlock
locations.desc: Five EVA suits on racks, the airlock and the dust-scrub bay.

locations.name: Rover Garage
locations.desc: Pressurized bay holding the rover, nicknamed the Mule.

locations.name: Surface
locations.desc: Rust-colored regolith, the solar field and the drill site. Suits required.

regions.name: Ares Deep
regions.status: five crew, 214 sols into a 500-sol rotation
regions.lore: The outpost itself: pressurized modules dug into the rim, run day to day by the crew and on paper by Mission Control.

regions.name: Hellas crater rim
regions.status: solar field and drill site working
regions.lore: Broken slopes around the outpost: the solar field, the ice drill site and the rover tracks. Suits required; dust devils and slope failures are common.

regions.name: Hellas basin floor
regions.lore: The deepest plain on Mars, kilometres below the rim. Thicker air, colder nights, and supply drops land there when they miss.

regions.name: Relay mast
regions.status: automated, checking in on the regional relay
regions.lore: An automated Halvorsen relay and weather station a day's drive along the rim, the nearest other built thing on the planet.

factions.name: Mission Control
factions.desc: The Ares program's ground team on Earth, 14 light-minutes away. Reviews everything the crew sends and decides on the second rotation.
factions.stance: supportive but anxious; reviewing this rotation's data for the renewal decision

factions.name: Halvorsen Aerospace
factions.desc: The corporate sponsor funding most of Ares Deep. Wants headlines and results it can sell.
factions.stance: publicly upbeat; privately watching costs and crew performance
